svg.title: Hiii! About Prachiti
svg.text: I'm Prachiti, an Artificial Intelligence graduate who's also
passionate about the creative world. Besides training models
and wrangling data, I love building tech that feels kind: tools
that help people type with their eyes, talk with their hands,
and find out whether their rent is actually fair.
For me, AI is a way to make the world a little more accessible
(and a lot more fun). I'm always up for collabs on accessibility,
ML for social good, and anything data-shaped.
